name: Tekka (Japanese Root Vegetables in Miso)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ⅔ cup chopped greater burdock root

steps: Heat a pan and pour in the sesame oil.
Add the greater burdock root, and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add the carrots and the lotus root and stir-fry for a few minutes.
Add miso and ginger. Turn down the heat and allow to cook over a low heat for 4 hours.
Stir frequently until all water has evaporated and until the mixture appears dry and dark.
Allow to cool and keep in a glass jar.

culture.text: Tekka is a miso condiment that consists of a number of root vegetables which have been stir-fried and boiled to a concentrated powder. Traditional preparation time used to be 16 hours, yet speedier preparation is possible.
